_doc: MakeCard: which graphs go into the fit and which nuisances act on them (was globalFitL3Res.C lines 354-1616). jecMakeCard turns this into card/<corLevel>/<epoch>/datacard.txt + shapes.root. Edit numbers HERE, never in the generated datacard.

default._samplesNote: was selectSample = MJDJ_gam_z_hadw, selectMethods = PtBalMPF (DP_2021). The order defines the order of channels and of the FSR nuisances.

multijet._note: alpha is the pT threshold (was ptmj). crecoil a30 is used for both methods when HDM is on (dofsr3mj).

zjet._scaleSource: globalFitL3Res.C:1337, 'Zmm mass within 0.2% of unity, Zee fixed to it'

default._fsrNote: FSR nuisances are fsr/hkfsr3_<method>_<sample>_<eigenvector> from softrad3. A sample with fsr = none still gets (inactive) rows, as today; see toDo.txt.
default._sourcesNote: Histogram nuisances from globalFitSyst. 'from: refIov' reads the reference IOV (was dsys). A source is skipped if none of its channels is in the fit.

samples._note: dijet PF composition; was fitPF_delta, minPFpt, maxPFpt (DP_2021 values)
Z+jet PF composition; was fitPFZ_delta, minPFZpt, maxPFZpt (DP_2021 values)

default._jesRefNote: Closure reference the model is divided by when corLevel = L1L2L3Res (was _hjesref, useL2L3ResForClosure).

gamjet._scaleSource: globalFitL3Res.C:1309, 'to better match scale from Zee'
